blocks.text: The National | Carney meets Trump face-to-face

Nov. 18, 2026 | Mark Carney meets face-to-face with Donald Trump at the APEC summit in their first meeting since trade talks collapsed. Waymo pulls its robotaxis from U.S. highways after a string of dangerous mishaps. And gamers around the world gear up for GTA-6.
